title: Appendix A exact catalog: Restore registry, cleanup, terminal history, and abandonment formats
description:
## What & scope
Freeze the exact Appendix A catalog slice for Restore registry, cleanup, terminal history, and abandonment formats. This task embeds source-plan lines 2349-2458 verbatim, expands every generic and role-indexed family into stable registered rows, and assigns each row to its granular implementation owner. It is a format/ownership contract, not a substitute implementation.

## Exact normative contract
The following audited source-plan text is authoritative and self-contained:

**Restore registry, source-lease operations, terminal compaction, and abandonment.** `RestoreRegistry` is the closed role union `Local{registry_generation,activity:Idle|OneLive{restore_id},entries[restore_id->LocalRestoreRegistryValue]}|Meta{registry_generation,activity:Idle|OneLive{restore_id},entries[restore_id->MetaRestoreRegistryValue]}|Shard{shard_id,registry_generation,activity:Idle|OneLive{restore_id},entries[restore_id->ShardRestoreRegistryValue]}`; role/group substitution or more than one live restore is unencodable. `RestoreLeaseOperationKind` is the closed type-level tag `Renew|Release`; `RestoreLeaseDispatchContract<Role,Kind>` is the generated exact family `Renew -> CanonicalRestoreArchiveLeaseRenewContract<Role>` and `Release -> CanonicalRestoreArchiveLeaseReleaseContract<Role>`. Those canonical contracts are distinct from the restore-prebootstrap renew/release contracts even when operation bodies are byte-equal. `RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalRecord<Role:AuthorityOwningRole,Kind:RestoreLeaseOperationKind>` is the exact `{authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,restore_id,lease_identity,operation_kind:Kind,dispatch_contract_id:RestoreLeaseDispatchContract<Role,Kind>,operation_id,idempotency_key_digest,canonical_action_body_digest,terminal:Applied{typed_receipt_ref:RestoreLeaseAppliedReceiptRef<Role,Kind>,portable_terminal_evidence_ref:StrongRef<PortableExternalActionTerminalEvidence<RestoreLeaseDispatchContract<Role,Kind>>>,terminal_import_ref:StrongRef<ExternalTerminalImportRecord<RestoreLeaseDispatchContract<Role,Kind>,Role>>,result_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,result_portable_lease_state_digest:RestoreLeaseAppliedResultState<Kind>}|NeverSent{dispatch_never_sent_proof_ref:StrongRef<DispatchNeverSentProof<RestoreLeaseDispatchContract<Role,Kind>>>,abandonment_publication_evidence_commitment,current_head_observation_ref:RestoreLeaseCurrentHeadObservationRef<Role,Kind>}|NoEffect{typed_provider_operation_tombstone_ref:RestoreLeaseNoEffectArtifactRef<Role,Kind>,portable_terminal_evidence_ref:StrongRef<PortableExternalActionTerminalEvidence<RestoreLeaseDispatchContract<Role,Kind>>>,terminal_import_ref:StrongRef<ExternalTerminalImportRecord<RestoreLeaseDispatchContract<Role,Kind>,Role>>,unchanged_head_observation_ref:RestoreLeaseCurrentHeadObservationRef<Role,Kind>,disposition:RestoreLeaseNoEffectDisposition<Kind>},body_digest}`. Detailed records own protected payload/evidence bytes and therefore retain the full nonwidenable authority binding through their status/replay floor; only the later payload-free proof accumulator may use a terminal authority commitment. `RestoreLeaseAppliedResultState<Renew>` requires the returned successor portable lease state and `RestoreLeaseAppliedResultState<Release>` requires the terminal released-head/no-successor commitment; `RestoreLeaseNoEffectDisposition<Kind>` and every receipt/artifact/observation ref are generated closed, kind-specific unions with no nullable or cross-kind arm. `RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalRecordRef<Role>` is exactly `Renew{record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalRecord<Role,Renew>>}|Release{record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalRecord<Role,Release>>}`. `RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalIndex<Role>` is the immutable map `(lease_identity,operation_kind,operation_id) -> RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalRecordRef<Role>`; every renewal/release terminal—success, never-sent abandonment, or no-effect—appends exactly one entry, so an operation ID can never disappear or be reused after later generations. `RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalAccumulator<Role>` is the checked compact authenticated map/MMR over the same sorted keys and terminal record canonical digests, with proof generation sufficient for status/nonreuse after the detailed replay floor closes. `RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalHistory<Role>` is `Detailed{index_ref:StrongRef<RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalIndex<Role>>}|Compacted{accumulator_ref:StrongRef<RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalAccumulator<Role>>,compacted_through_floor}`. `RestoreRegistryCommon<Role:AuthorityOwningRole>` is `{authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,restore_id,restore_epoch,mode:RecoverSameIdentity|CloneNewIdentity,source_posture,target_posture,source_manifest_identity,target_database_and_security_identity,target_incarnation,service_visibility_epoch,source_lease_identity:RestoreSourceLeaseIdentity,transform_plan_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationTransformPlan<Role>>,projection_result_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationProjectionResult<Role>>,source_key_access_inventory_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceKeyAccessInventory<Role>>,lease_bound_source_access_set_ref:StrongRef<RestoreLeaseBoundSourceAccessSet<Role>>,prebootstrap_evidence_state:RestorePreBootstrapEvidenceState<Role>,lease_operation_terminal_history:RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalHistory<Role>,state_generation}`. Both source-access edges exist from the first bridge until cleanup generation zero atomically assumes ownership; detailed prebootstrap-evidence compaction cannot collect them.

Restore phase and lease operation are orthogonal. `RestoreLeaseState<Role:AuthorityOwningRole>` is exactly `Current{latest_lease_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRecord<Role>>}|RenewAuthorizedUndispatched{latest_lease_record_ref,operation_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRenewOperationRecord<Role>>,resume_phase_commitment}|RenewalClosed{latest_lease_record_ref,renewal_close_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRenewalCloseRecord<Role>>}|ReleaseAuthorizedUndispatched{latest_lease_record_ref,renewal_close_record_ref,operation_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseReleaseOperationRecord<Role>>,completion_evidence_ref:RestoreCompletionEvidenceRef<Role>}`. Only one renewal or release can exist. Renewal is legal in every hidden/recovery phase that still needs the source, including RecoveryAbandoned, but `RestoreSourceKeyAccessCleanupFinalizeSpec<Role>` may enter AwaitingSourceRelease only by proving no unresolved renewal and atomically creating `RestoreSourceLeaseRenewalCloseRecord<Role> {authority_bound_header,restore_id,lease_identity,latest_generation_and_lineage_checkpoint,complete_renew_operation_terminal_history_commitment,zero_authorized_armed_sent_unknown_or_import-pending_renewal_proof,closed_at_applied_identity,body_digest}` plus `RenewalClosed`. No renew authorization or retry is inhabitable afterward. Release is legal only from AwaitingSourceRelease + RenewalClosed. A lease operation freezes the exact restore phase and finalization returns to that phase or advances its one registered terminal path.

If a renew authorization becomes audit-visible but eligibility expires before an Armed attempt is published, `RestoreSourceLeaseRenewAuthorizedNeverArmedFinalizeSpec<Role>` consumes the operation record, a current zero-attempt-membership proof over the exact Protocol attempt slot, current ineligibility evidence, and a permanent operation-ID/request nonreuse tombstone; it appends a distinct `AuthorizedNeverArmed` terminal-history member and returns the unchanged lease to Current/frozen phase. It does not require `DispatchNeverSentProof`, which exists only after Armed publication. Release has the symmetric `RestoreSourceLeaseReleaseAuthorizedNeverArmedFinalizeSpec<Role>` for administrative cancellation or invalidated authority before Arm; lease expiry alone does not force that path because the release cleanup contract remains exactly retryable after expiry. Once Armed exists, only the registered never-sent, status, no-effect, or applied paths are legal.

`RestoreSourceKeyAccessResource` is the generated exact inventory member for every source-`K_oid`, bootstrap-DEK, object-DEK, transient unwrap/rewrap grant, threshold share, HSM session, archive-escrow release, ephemeral plaintext opener, and one-shot provider handle created by the acquisition bundle. `RestoreSourceKeyAccessInventory<Role:AuthorityOwningRole>` is constructed before the first bridge and installed by it as `{authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,restore_id,source_lease_identity,source_acquisition_bundle_identity_and_digest,sorted_resources[RestoreSourceKeyAccessResource],each_resource_origin_provider_contract_recipient_subject_lease_binding_and_canonical_owner,complete_bundle_artifact_receipt_opener_grant_share_session_handle_to_resource_bijection,zero_unclassified_source_access,inventory_digest,body_digest}`. It owns the exact canonical resource records/copies, not the acquisition bundle or a prebootstrap locator. `RestoreLeaseBoundSourceAccessSet<Role>` is the separate pre-order `{authority_bound_header,restore_id,source_lease_identity,source_access_inventory_identity_and_digest,sorted_members[{resource_identity,resource_kind,provider_contract_identity_and_digest,provider_binding_proves_no_use_after_matching_release:true}],complete_lease_bound_subset_proof,set_digest,body_digest}`. It contains no release body, disposition, operation, or receipt. The first bridge makes the registry own both objects; cleanup generation zero atomically assumes those edges, so evidence compaction cannot collect them.

`RestoreSourceKeyAccessDisposition` is the closed union `PromotedCurrentTargetKey{resource_identity,required_kind:PreservedSameIdentityObjectIdKey,key_equality_and_target_authority_proof}|LeaseBoundAutoRevoked{resource_identity,lease_bound_set_membership_proof,provider_contract_identity_and_digest,source_lease_identity,canonical_release_action_body_digest,provider_binding_proves_no_use_after_matching_release:true}|ExplicitlyRevoked{resource_identity,revocation_dispatch_contract_id,revocation_operation_id,typed_receipt_ref,portable_terminal_evidence_ref,terminal_import_ref,provider_head_and_counter_commitment}|ProviderAlreadyClosedNoUse{resource_identity,typed_provider_closed_tombstone_ref,portable_terminal_evidence_ref,terminal_import_ref,zero_successor_or_reopen_proof}|EphemeralUseConsumedAndClosed{resource_identity,required_kind:OneShotThresholdShare|HsmSession|PlaintextOpener|OneShotArchiveEscrowRelease,one_shot_provider_contract_identity_and_digest,consumption_or_session_close_terminal_evidence,local_zeroization_evidence,no_replay_or_successor_proof}`. The canonical release action body names only `RestoreLeaseBoundSourceAccessSet<Role>.set_digest`; dispositions may later name that already-computable body digest, so no identity cycle exists. `PromotedCurrentTargetKey` is uninhabited for clone source keys or any DEK/transient grant. `EphemeralUseConsumedAndClosed` is uninhabited for any renewable grant, reusable key, retained unwrap authority, or resource with a provider revocation endpoint.

`RestoreSourceAccessRevocationOperationRecord<Role:AuthorityOwningRole,Kind>` is the exact `{authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,restore_id,source_lease_identity,source_resource_identity,resource_kind:Kind,expected_provider_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,dispatch_contract_id:RestoreSourceAccessRevocationContract<Role,Kind>,operation_id,idempotency_key_digest,canonical_action_body_recipe_and_digest,authorized_from_progress_generation,resume_progress_recipe,terminal_audit_gate_commitment,body_digest}`; it contains no future attempt, publication evidence, receipt, provider result, or successor progress. `RestoreSourceKeyAccessCleanupProgress<Role>` is the generationed exact `{authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,restore_id,source_lease_identity,source_access_inventory_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceKeyAccessInventory<Role>>,lease_bound_source_access_set_ref:StrongRef<RestoreLeaseBoundSourceAccessSet<Role>>,progress_generation,sorted_resource_states[(resource_identity)->PromotedTargetKeyTerminal{proof_commitment}|EphemeralClosedTerminal{close_and_zeroization_evidence_commitment}|LeaseBoundPendingRelease{set_membership_proof,provider_contract_identity_and_digest}|ExplicitRevocationPending{resource_kind,current_provider_head_and_contract_body_recipe,prior_terminal_operation_history}|ExplicitRevocationAuthorized{operation_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceAccessRevocationOperationRecord<Role,ExactResourceKind>>,dispatch_contract_id,operation_id}|ExplicitRevocationPendingAfterAuthorizedNeverArmed{retired_operation_record_ref,zero_attempt_membership_and_operation_nonreuse_tombstone_ref,next_operation_recipe}|ExplicitRevocationTerminal{operation_record_ref,portable_terminal_evidence_ref:StrongRef<PortableExternalActionTerminalEvidence<RestoreSourceAccessRevocationContract<Role,ExactResourceKind>>>,typed_receipt_ref,terminal_import_ref,provider_head_and_counter_commitment}|ProviderAlreadyClosedTerminal{typed_closed_tombstone_evidence_and_import}],outstanding_explicit_revocation_bitmap,complete_source_resource_to_state_bijection,current_terminal_pin_basis_commitment,required_shard_source_access_closure_set_commitment,body_digest}`. Each explicit revocation has its own canonical-plane contract instance; response loss is status-resolved under the same contract/operation bytes. Authorization moves only Pending -> Authorized. If eligibility disappears before Armed, an exact zero-attempt/nonreuse finalize appends history and returns the resource to PendingAfterAuthorizedNeverArmed; it does not pretend the resource is closed. No digest-only “done” state or untyped progress owner is legal.

`RestoreSourceKeyAccessCleanupAccumulator<Role>` is the checked compact `{authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,restore_id,source_lease_identity,source_access_inventory_and_lease_bound_set_commitment,sorted_terminal_resource_projections[RestoreSourceKeyAccessTerminalProjection<Role>],complete_source_inventory_and_required_shard_closure_to_disposition_bijection,zero_unclassified_or_live_source_access_proof,canonical_release_action_body_and_lease_bound_set_binding_commitment,detailed_terminal_evidence_retention_floor,checker_version,accumulator_root,body_digest}`. `RestoreSourceKeyAccessTerminalProjection<Role>` is a generated closed per-disposition union; each arm carries exactly its legal operation/request/status/receipt/import/provider-head/nonreuse or promoted/ephemeral proof commitment, with no nullable fields. Because the accumulator owns protected proof/status bytes, it retains the full authority header until a later payload-free digest tombstone after its floor. `RestoreSourceKeyAccessCleanupRecord<Role>` is `{authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,restore_id,source_lease_identity,source_access_inventory_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceKeyAccessInventory<Role>>,lease_bound_source_access_set_ref:StrongRef<RestoreLeaseBoundSourceAccessSet<Role>>,final_progress_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceKeyAccessCleanupProgress<Role>>,sorted_resource_dispositions[RestoreSourceKeyAccessDisposition],required_shard_source_access_closure_refs:RestoreRequiredShardSourceAccessClosureSet<Role>,complete_provider_resource_and_shard_closure_to_disposition_bijection,independent_reopen_or_abandonment_basis,zero_unclassified_source_access_proof,canonical_release_action_body_recipe_and_digest,accumulator_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceKeyAccessCleanupAccumulator<Role>>,body_digest}`. `RestoreRequiredShardSourceAccessClosureSet<Local>` is the exact empty proof; `<Meta>` is every-and-only configured certified `ShardRestoreSourceAccessClosure`. Cleanup finalize requires zero Pending, Authorized, SentUnknown, import-pending, or unresolved renewal; constructs the stable release body over the pre-order set digest; creates the accumulator, record, renewal-close record, and generation; and atomically enters AwaitingSourceRelease + RenewalClosed. The completion/pin-install transition that first enters AwaitingSourceAccessCleanup must simultaneously construct progress generation zero from every inventory member and required Shard closure—there is no phase with a missing progress owner. Later checked compaction may drop detailed records only after the accumulator's declared status/replay floor.

Physical pin ownership is terminal-disposition-shaped rather than promotion-shaped. `RestoreTerminalDisposition` is the closed tag `Operational|Abandoned`. `RestoreTerminalPhysicalInventory<Role,Disposition>` is the exact role/disposition-refined `{authority_binding:AuthorityBindingFor<Role>,restore_id,restore_epoch,role_and_group,terminal_disposition:Disposition,source_root_manifest_slot_and_publication_commitment,sorted_logical_members[{typed_object_ref,logical_kind,schema_and_format_epoch,key_and_wrap_member,encoding_member,placement_member,segment_or_extent_membership,keep_through_terminal_floor_or_later_gc_disposition}],sorted_physical_generation_lease_and_fence_members,complete_object_ciphertext_encoding_key_wrap_placement_segment_extent_and_lease_bijection,availability_requirement:IndependentReopen|OperationalAck|AbandonmentForensicsAndSafeGc,reopen_or_forensics_checker_profile,complete_closure_proof_ref,inventory_digest,body_digest}`.

`RestorePromotionRootSealRecipe<Role>` is the pre-order `{restore_id,role_and_group,promotion_or_open_applied_identity,canonical_publication_evidence,sealed_role_state_root_identity,sealed_root_manifest_identity,winning_root_slot_generation_and_digest,promotion_authority_profile_and_composite_receipt_digest,service_visibility_epoch,operational_inventory_identity_and_digest,planned_pin_id_and_generation,allowed_pending_reopen_successor_classes,recipe_digest}`. It excludes the pin durability receipt, seal identity/digest, seal-install result, reopen proof, and every later acknowledgement. `RestoreTerminalPinOwnerSubject<Role,Disposition>` is exact: `Operational{promotion_seal_recipe:RestorePromotionRootSealRecipe<Role>}` or `Abandoned{abandonment_publication_evidence,abandonment_tombstone_ref:RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneRef<Role>,zero_service_commitment}`.

`RestoreTerminalPinOperationFamily<Role,Disposition>` pre-mints one activation and one release operation/contract/idempotency/body recipe for every exact storage-domain member range in the inventory. `RestoreTerminalPinIndex<Role>` is the DB-owned immutable map `pin_id -> RestoreTerminalPinLedgerEntry<Role,Disposition>`, rooted by the role's RetentionMap/restore anchor. The entry is the closed generationed state `ActivationPending{authority_binding,inventory_ref,owner_subject,operation_family_ref,outstanding_activation_bitmap}|Active{authority_binding,inventory_ref,owner_subject,operation_family_ref,activation_receipt_ref:StrongRef<RestoreTerminalPinDurabilityReceipt<Role,Disposition>>}|ReleaseAuthorized{authority_binding,inventory_ref,owner_subject,operation_family_ref,activation_receipt_ref,release_authorization_ref,outstanding_release_bitmap}|Released{terminal_authority_commitment,inventory_digest,owner_subject_public_commitment,activation_and_release_accumulator_root,release_completion_identity,provider_status_and_nonreuse_floor}`. Each storage-domain activation/release uses its exact canonical universal-dispatch contract; timeout is never an acknowledgement, and the ledger records every Armed/SentUnknown/status/terminal lineage.

The sequences are noninterchangeable:

- `DirectoryBoundCataloged`: the canonical catalog tombstone is installed first. Ordered `DirectoryBoundAbandonApplySpec {authority_bound_header,restore_id,abandon_operation_record_ref,skeleton_ref,pending_owner_ref,catalog_terminal_disposition,current_creation_evidence_ref,live_target_manifest_inode_lease_and_publication_sequencer,fixed_local_continuity_digest,exact_predecessor_root_and_slot,assigned_result_slot_generation,expected_result_payload_manifest_and_receipt_body_recipes_excluding_all_result_and_tombstone_digests,terminal_audit_gate}` then clears `restore_state_ref`, selects `RecoveryAbandoned`, and enters `AbandonedAuthorityAppliedAwaitingReceipt` under the same inode fence. Its tombstone names the earlier apply result/receipt, never the receipt-import result that contains it.
- `DirectoryBoundEmbeddedNoCatalog`: the same local apply/receipt sequence runs with the zero-catalog-applicability proof and no catalog operation or placeholder version.

Sharded abandonment has an explicit Meta-to-Shard authority bridge; a Shard never acts from prose, a raw external receipt, or a digest-only projection. After the ExternalCas catalog/continuity terminal imports and `RestoreAbandonmentReceipt::ExternalCasCataloged` are durable, Meta orders `GlobalRestoreAbandonParticipantApplyAuthorizeSpec {restore_id,restore_epoch,abandon_operation_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreAbandonOperationRecord<Meta>>,abandonment_manifest_ref:StrongRef<RestoreAbandonmentManifest>,external_abandonment_receipt_ref:ExternalCasRestoreAbandonmentReceiptRef,meta_no_target_observation_proof_ref,exact_sorted_shard_no_observation_refs,expected_source_meta_prefix_and_configuration,required_shard_set_and_topology_commitment,meta_pending_owner_ref,sorted_shard_recipe_entries[{shard_id,tombstone_skeleton_recipe:RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneSkeletonRecipe<Shard>,pending_owner_recipe:RestoreAbandonmentPinPendingOwnerRecipe<Shard>,recipe_availability_and_retention_certificate}],complete_proof_recipe_shard_and_group_bijection,terminal_audit_gate}`. Each Shard locally expands and verifies only its certified recipe bytes, then orders `ShardRestoreAbandonApplySpec {authorization_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<GlobalRestoreAbandonParticipantApplyCertificate>,own_entry_ordinal,own_no_target_observation_proof_ref:StrongRef<RestoreNoTargetObservationProof<Shard>>,current_restore_state_ref:StrongRef<RestoreState>,current_registry_ref:StrongRef<RestoreRegistry>,current_source_lease_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreSourceLeaseProjection>,constructed_tombstone_skeleton_ref:RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneSkeletonRef<Shard>,constructed_pending_owner_ref:StrongRef<RestoreAbandonmentPinPendingOwner<Shard>>,complete_recipe_expansion_availability_and_entry_match_proof,expected_source_meta_prefix_configuration_and_topology}` under the matching `ShardControlAuthority::MetaAuthorized` arm. Apply clears `restore_state_ref`, selects RecoveryAbandoned, materializes the role-correct Shard tombstone from the certified basis, installs `RestoreRetentionAnchor::AbandonmentPinPending`, and enters `AbandonedAwaitingTerminalPin`; it contains no future publication evidence, pin, or acknowledgement. After the role-valid abandonment-pin install and the separate Shard source-access close transition, the Shard may create exact `RestoreShardAbandonAck {SameGroupCertificateHeader,authorization_certificate_identity,restore_id,restore_epoch,shard_id,abandon_apply_applied_identity,abandonment_pin_install_applied_identity,source_access_close_applied_identity,abandonment_tombstone_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreAbandonmentTombstone>,abandoned_terminal_pin_basis_ref:AbandonedRestoreTerminalPinBasisRef<Shard>,source_access_closure_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreSourceAccessClosure>,terminalizing_projection_commitment,post_close_shard_state_root_ref:StrongRef<ShardLogicalStateRoot>,root_slot_durability_digest,source_lease_projection_identity_generation_and_digest,no_service_and_no_same_incarnation_successor_commitment,certificate_attempt_ref:StrongRef<CertificateAttemptRecord>,canonical_signature_set}`. `GlobalRestoreAbandonFinalizeSpec` consumes the same authorization, manifest, external receipt, Meta pending owner, and every-and-only required certified Shard ack; missing, duplicate, wrong-configuration, wrong-recipe, wrong-disposition, missing source-access closure, or wrong-restore acknowledgements remain blocking. It then creates the Meta abandonment tombstone and enters Meta `AbandonedAwaitingTerminalPin`. This order ensures no Meta terminal can discard the participant recipe/proof/closure before all Shards have durably accepted it.

`RestoreAbandonmentReceipt` is the portable closed union `ExternalCasCataloged{catalog_tombstone_lineage,continuity_abandon_lineage,complete_profile_stage_bijection}|DirectoryBoundCataloged{catalog_tombstone_lineage,directory_bound_abandonment_receipt_bytes_and_digest,complete_profile_stage_bijection}|DirectoryBoundEmbeddedNoCatalog{directory_bound_abandonment_receipt_bytes_and_digest,zero_catalog_applicability_proof_digest,complete_profile_stage_bijection}`. Reversing a cataloged profile's order is illegal because it could leave an unowned endpoint reservation. For ExternalCas, `LocalRestoreAbandonFinalizeSpec` consumes the exact canonical profile evidence, clears `restore_state_ref`, selects `RecoveryAbandoned`, materializes the Local tombstone, and enters `AbandonedAwaitingTerminalPin`; for DirectoryBound, `DirectoryBoundAbandonReceiptImportSpec` is the sole tombstone materializer and transition from `AbandonedAuthorityAppliedAwaitingReceipt`. `ShardRestoreAbandonApplySpec` and `GlobalRestoreAbandonFinalizeSpec` likewise end in their role-specific `AbandonedAwaitingTerminalPin`, never directly in participant-complete or cleanup. Only after exact Shard source-access closure may it create an abandon ack; only after Local/Meta progress generation zero may cleanup begin. It rejects ordinary open, service, sessions, capabilities, user work, unrelated maintenance, reconfiguration, and resurrection. These evidence-maintenance successors are included in the seal/allowed-successor registry so a delayed journal-key cut cannot deadlock release. A later same-identity restore must reserve a strictly higher incarnation.

`RecoveryTransformSourceBasis<Role>` is the generated role family `Local{working_set_ref:StrongRef<RestoreCanonicalAcquisitionWorkingSet<Local>>,stable_lease_identity,construction_observed_lease_generation_and_portable_state_digest,live_prebootstrap_dispatch_root_commitment}|Meta{working_set_ref:StrongRef<RestoreCanonicalAcquisitionWorkingSet<Meta>>,stable_lease_identity,construction_observed_lease_generation_and_portable_state_digest,live_prebootstrap_dispatch_root_commitment}|Shard{certified_bootstrap_projection_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<RestoreShardBootstrapProjectionCertificate>,stable_lease_identity,construction_observed_projection_generation_and_portable_state_digest,exact_archive_inventory_and_key_recipient_subset}`. Each recipe is exactly `ReaddressAndReprotect{source:RestoreArchiveRef<T>,target_kind_and_schema,canonical_body_recipe,references_to_earlier_mapping_entries[],target_physical_profile,target_key_recipient_profile}|ReuseIncarnationNeutral{source,neutrality_registry_row,proof_of_no_incarnation_authority_capability_or_reference_fields,target_availability_recipe}|CarryPriorIncarnationEvidence{source,evidence_class,original_canonical_bytes_and_signature_digest,original_signer_domain_and_verification_chain,target_prior_evidence_registry_slot}|RecreateCurrentAuthority{source_evidence_inputs[],target_configuration_key_or_certificate_recipe,target_signing_ceremony_ref}|InvalidateOrSuspendCapability{source_capability_or_protocol_owner_domain,invalidation_or_suspension_recipe,reauthentication_policy}|Reject{stable_reason}`. ## Ownership, verification, and diagnostics
For every schema, field, tag, state, transition, reference, digest transcript, construction-order rule, and role restriction in this slice, generate a durable_fields.toml row with stable IDs; canonical encoding/version policy; concrete generic/role expansion; producer, owner bead/crate, and consumers; reference strength/target set; authority and redaction class; invariant/evidence/cost bindings; test/scenario/event IDs; and consuming gate. Cross-slice targets use stable catalog IDs and must resolve in the Appendix A epic closure. Downstream owners may add implementation detail but cannot abbreviate, alias, weaken, or contradict these bytes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The embedded line range is byte-complete, checksum-pinned, continuous with adjacent slices, and contains no truncation marker.
- Every exact named construct in the slice has one stable row and exactly one granular implementation owner; all references and consumers resolve.
- Unit tests cover canonical encode/decode, stable field/tag IDs, role/generic expansion, digest construction, state preconditions, and owner uniqueness.
- Property/mutation/fuzz tests remove, duplicate, reorder, retag, corrupt, weaken, or cross-role substitute every field/arm/reference class and prove rejection.
- Simulation tests exercise applicable crash, cancellation, retry, sent-unknown, receipt-first, recovery, authority/configuration rotation, compaction, and expiry boundaries.
- E2E scripts traverse each applicable public embedded/server/FGP/CLI path through durable publication, restart/replay, backup/restore, and terminal cleanup using isolated synthetic fixtures.
- Detailed versioned JSONL diagnostics carry schema_id, field_or_arm_id, role/group, object or public commitment, transition_id, state_before/state_after, checker, verdict, artifact refs, and replay command; secret/noninterference tests reject protected data or observable hidden state.
- Cross-version golden vectors and unknown-required-field fixtures enforce additive-minor/breaking-major policy; no gate passes with an uncovered row.

## Risks & rejected alternatives
Rejected: family-level prose summaries, wildcard references, inferred fields, unregistered aliases, or treating the catalog slice as the implementation. Exactness is intentional; execution remains decomposed across the linked workstream beads.

  instruments are silent (that is what `unclassified` means here) and all four
  measure 0. If the rule holds, the answer is WIRE for all four, and this is its
  second case — which is the condition you set for recording it as a law.

  What I need from you: confirm the rule extends, or name the reason it does not.

--- GROUP B: three field-scoped unions, logical OR physical (3 rows) ---

  PreBootstrapCatalogTombstoneRestoreTargetActionBody.catalog_profile  producer guue
  ShardRestoreRegistryTerminalizingProjection.terminal_disposition     producer msk
  ShardRestoreTerminalPinReleaseSpec.expected_registry_state           producer msk

  Blocked by: field_unresolved_schema AND ordinary_union_unresolved_schema.
  Options: logical | physical. Cost identical.

  THE xfrc RULE DOES NOT REACH THESE, and I do not think it should be stretched.
  It discriminates logical-vs-wire by trading a permanent object_kind code for
  renewable rows. Logical-vs-physical spends a permanent code EITHER WAY
  (object_kind vs record_kind), so "spend the renewable resource" is silent here.
  These three need a different discriminator, and I would rather ask than invent
  one.

  The obvious candidate, if you want a rule rather than three calls: a physical
  record_kind is for something the storage layer materialises as a record;
  `catalog_profile`, `terminal_disposition` and `expected_registry_state` all
  read as VALUES INSIDE a host record, which argues logical. But that is a
  reading of three names, not a measurement, and I will not land it as a
  convention on that basis.

--- WHAT I AM NOT ASKING YOU TO RULE ---

The three prose-only generated families (RestoreTerminalPinOwnerSubject<Role,
Disposition>, RestoreSourceKeyAccessTerminalProjection<Role>,
RestoreLeaseDispatchContract<Role,Kind>) are NOT in this request. They need the
producer to spell the payloads before a class question even arises, and one of
them (the N=5 projection) is uncostable until then. They stay blocked on fjz0
and 241 as design work, which is the real thing they wait on.

--- WHAT LANDS IF YOU RULE ---

Group A alone: 4 unions, 24 projection rows + 24 targets, all currently
`status = "reserved"`. Group A + B: 7 unions, 42 + 42. The satisfiability
question is already settled — both ordinary-union fixtures emit zero codes, so
`ordinary_union_unresolved_schema` is satisfiable and these are landable rather
than errata. Nothing else in a4fq is waiting on anything I can move.

title: Appendix A exact catalog: Restore lease barrier, reservations, bridge, and readiness formats
description:
## What & scope
Freeze the exact Appendix A catalog slice for Restore lease barrier, reservations, bridge, and readiness formats. This task embeds source-plan lines 2459-2574 verbatim, expands every generic and role-indexed family into stable registered rows, and assigns each row to its granular implementation owner. It is a format/ownership contract, not a substitute implementation.

## Exact normative contract
The following audited source-plan text is authoritative and self-contained:

Execution is leaves-first. `ReaddressAndReprotect` opens/verifies source bytes, substitutes only earlier target mappings, canonical-encodes, computes the new ObjectId, encrypts under new AEAD AAD containing that ObjectId, computes CiphertextId, builds complete encoding/placement/opener/wrap records, and verifies recoverability. Changed bodies cannot reuse old ciphertext. Historical external signatures are carried byte-identically and never presented as target authority; current configurations/certificates/keys/trust are recreated. The completed `RecoveryIncarnationProjectionResult<Role> {plan_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationTransformPlan<Role>>,source_recovery_projection_digest,sorted_source_to_target_entries[],target_semantic_root_recipes,target_protocol_reconstruction_recipes,target_prepared_root_recipes,target_consensus_bootstrap_recipes,target_bootstrap_and_physical_inventory,target_availability_certificates,carried_prior_evidence_registry_root,invalidated_or_suspended_capability_and_protocol_owner_root,recreated_current_authority_root,no_missing_duplicate_or_unclassified_entry_proof,posture_preservation_proof,applied_visible_nonwidening_proof,semantic_equivalence_digest,plane_complete_slot_coverage_proof,complete_field_and_object_coverage_digest}` exists before any bridge and names no future root. RecoverSameIdentity preserves the applied/visible gap and pending queue. Clone accepts only CloneExportReady or explicit hidden-entry dispositions, and no recipe transplants source Raft hard state as current target consensus state.

The prior-incarnation barrier is per issuer and per homogeneous lease cohort, with future receipt values represented only as typed holes. `PriorLeaseCohortInventoryRecipe` is the pre-fence reference-free `{cohort_recipe_id,continuity_domain_id,database_security_namespace_id,prior_incarnation,issuer_id,issuer_configuration_identity_and_digest,issuer_authority_epoch,time_authority_profile_oid,time_domain_id,time_authority_epoch,permitted_scope_set,permitted_generation_and_counter_ranges,maximum_issued_generation,source_issuance_ledger_inventory_root_and_configuration_proof_digest,issuance_fence_receipt_digest_hole,cohort_fence_closure_row_digest_hole,final_window_digest_hole}`. A cohort may contain only leases whose issuer, authority/profile/domain epochs, scope class, and counter/generation range interpretation are identical; mixed profile/domain/epoch leases are split before planning. `CohortDispositionDecisionRecipe` is `{cohort_recipe_id,decision_policy:ExpiredOnlyWithDefinitivePreBootstrapAttestationOtherwiseRevoke,revoke_operation_id,revoke_idempotency_digest,revoke_action_body_template_with_fence_receipt_and_window_digest_holes,expiry_attestation_subject_template,cleanup_recipe}`. RestoreFencePending and the Phase-A plan commit the exact sorted recipe/decision sets and pre-minted revoke operation identities—not a future cohort-window or receipt digest. No maximum-lifetime arithmetic or counter-to-time inference is accepted as authority.

`PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortFenceClosureRow` is the portable signed `{cohort_recipe_id,issuer_id,issuer_authority_epoch,time_authority_profile_oid,time_domain_id,time_authority_epoch,covered_generation_and_counter_ranges,last_legal_issuance_or_renewal_counter,maximum_issued_or_renewed_expires_at:AuthorityInstant,issuance_ledger_accumulator_root,range_completeness_proof,source_inventory_configuration_and_recipe_match_digest,no_future_issue_or_renew_for_covered_range:true,row_digest}`. Its `AuthorityInstant` must use the cohort's exact profile/domain/epoch and is the maximum actual expiry found by an authenticated exhaustive issuance-ledger range proof—not a derived duration.

`PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFenceReceipt` is the portable `{external_request_binding:ExternalActionRequestBinding{action_kind=PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFence},issuer_id,issuer_configuration_identity_and_digest,issuer_authority_epoch,covered_generation_and_counter_ranges,prior_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,result_fenced_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,sorted_cohort_closure_rows[PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortFenceClosureRow],complete_recipe_range_issuance_ledger_and_row_bijection,last_legal_issuance_or_renewal_counter,global_no_future_prior_incarnation_issue_or_renew:true,issuer_counter,signer_set_epoch,signatures}`. After that receipt is terminally imported, the journal fills each matching typed hole and constructs exact `PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortWindow {cohort_recipe_id,issuer_fence_receipt_digest,cohort_closure_row_bytes_and_digest,time_authority_profile_oid,time_domain_id,time_authority_epoch,covered_generation_and_counter_ranges,maximum_issued_or_renewed_expires_at,issuance_ledger_accumulator_and_range_completeness_commitment,window_digest}`. For each exact window it durably selects `CohortDispositionDecision = Expired{prebootstrap_expiry_attestation_artifact_ref}` only when a definitive `PreBootstrapPortableTimeExpiryAttestation` for that same profile/domain/epoch proves `observation_interval.earliest >= maximum_issued_or_renewed_expires_at`; otherwise it selects `Revoke{precommitted_operation_id_and_filled_action_body}`. An expiry crossing after planning is therefore resolved from current evidence, never from a stale guessed decision.

`PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortRevocationReceipt` is the distinct portable `{external_request_binding:ExternalActionRequestBinding{action_kind=PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortRevoke},issuer_id,cohort_key,cohort_window_digest,covered_generation_and_counter_subrange,prior_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,result_revoked_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,no_future_use_proof,issuer_counter,signer_set_epoch,signatures}`. Both actions use the restore-prebootstrap dispatch plane and action-specific source gate. The revoke request must be the filled version of the precommitted template and retain the same operation/idempotency identities; a different window or post-fence operation is not equivalent.

`PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFenceRow` is the reference-free portable projection `{issuer_id,issuer_kind:OnlineContinuity|OfflineIssuer,issuer_configuration_identity_and_digest,issuer_authority_epoch,covered_generation_and_counter_ranges,predecessor_head_digest_and_cas_version,resulting_fenced_head_digest_and_cas_version,fence_receipt_identity_and_digest,sorted_cohort_closure_row_digests,complete_recipe_range_and_row_bijection,terminal_evidence_identity_and_digest,no_future_prior_incarnation_issue_or_renew:true,issuer_counter}`. `PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortDisposition` is exactly `Revoked{cohort_recipe_id,cohort_window_digest,cohort_closure_row_digest,decision_record_digest,issuer_fence_row_key,covered_generation_and_counter_subrange,revocation_operation_id,revocation_receipt_identity_and_digest,terminal_evidence_identity_and_digest}|Expired{cohort_recipe_id,cohort_window_digest,cohort_closure_row_digest,maximum_issued_or_renewed_expires_at,decision_record_digest,prebootstrap_portable_expiry_attestation_identity_and_digest}`. An Expired arm is legal only when the separately imported prebootstrap attestation's subject, profile, time domain, authority epoch, window, maximum expiry, basis, and intended barrier action equal that cohort; a Revoked arm is legal only when the issuer's fenced ranges cover the cohort completely and the action is the filled precommitted template. No receipt, expiry, or time-domain mapping is inferred from a successor head, counter, nominal lifetime, or unaddressable inline pseudo-object.

`LeasesRevokedOrExpiredThrough` is the external reference-free certificate `{database_security_namespace_id,continuity_profile_id,restore_id,prior_incarnation,planned_target_incarnation,current_restore_fence_pending_digest,current_cas_version,cohort_inventory_recipe_set_digest,cohort_disposition_decision_recipe_set_digest,exact_issuer_configuration_set_commitment,sorted_issuer_fence_rows[PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFenceRow],exact_cohort_window_set_commitment,sorted_cohort_dispositions[PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortDisposition],complete_recipe_to_window_to_decision_to_action_or_attestation_bijection,complete_issuer_and_cohort_bijection_commitment,no_future_prior_incarnation_lease_issuance_or_renewal_proof,authority_tick,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. It intentionally names the already-existing RestoreFencePending head and planned target, never the later RestoreReserved result. Mixed Revoked and Expired cohorts are normal; there is no all-revoked/all-expired union, cross-issuer maximum generation, cross-epoch scalar expiry, or unsigned range shortcut.

Barrier signing is not a hidden external side effect. The `EnterRestoreReserved` request carries the complete unsigned barrier body/row commitment through `PriorLeaseBarrierCompleteGate`. The continuity authority verifies every issuer/cohort receipt, expiry attestation, no-future-issuance proof, and bijection; in one registered CAS operation it signs the portable barrier naming the existing RestoreFencePending head, computes its digest, and CASes the direct RestoreReserved successor that commits that digest. `EnterRestoreReservedReceipt` begins with `ExternalActionRequestBinding{action_kind=EnterRestoreReserved}` and contains `{prior_fence_pending_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,signed_barrier_bytes_and_digest,result_restore_reserved_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,target_incarnation,plan_and_journal_commitment,continuity_counter,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. Thus the signed barrier and result head are returned together, with no future-reference cycle or separate signing call.

Before target `K_oid`, RestoreReserved consumes only the portable barrier digest plus the sealed prebootstrap action/artifact lineage committed by its source gate; a local barrier-import ObjectId cannot yet exist. `PortableRestoreContinuityAncestryProof` is the reference-free authority-signed `{restore_id,target_incarnation,ordered_heads[{transition_kind:EnterRestoreFencePending|EnterRestoreReserved|CommitAcquisitionRefinementBootstrapOpeners|CommitAcquisitionRefinementVerifiedObjectInventory,head_bytes_digest,cas_version,predecessor_head_digest,operation_id,canonical_request_digest}],enter_restore_reserved_receipt_digest,barrier_digest,current_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,allowed_chain_complete:true,continuity_counter,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. The chain must begin at the exact FencePending head, include the exact receipt-returned RestoreReserved successor, then contain zero or the two ordered refinement successors and no other transition.

After target `K_oid` exists but still before the first RootManifest, creation constructs `PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierBootstrapImport<Role:AuthorityOwningRole> {authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,role_and_group,restore_fence_pending_record_ref:StrongRef<ClusterIncarnationContinuityRecord>,cohort_inventory_and_decision_recipe_set_commitment,sorted_cohort_window_refs[StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortWindow>],portable_barrier_ref:StrongRef<LeasesRevokedOrExpiredThrough>,enter_restore_reserved_receipt_ref:StrongRef<EnterRestoreReservedReceipt>,enter_restore_reserved_terminal_evidence_ref:StrongRef<PortableExternalActionTerminalEvidence<EnterRestoreReserved>>,enter_restore_reserved_prebootstrap_terminal_import_artifact_identity_bytes_and_digest,continuity_ancestry_proof_ref:StrongRef<PortableRestoreContinuityAncestryProof>,sorted_issuer_fence_imports[{issuer_row_key,fence_receipt_ref:StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFenceReceipt>,portable_terminal_evidence_ref:StrongRef<PortableExternalActionTerminalEvidence<PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFence>>,prebootstrap_terminal_import_artifact_identity_bytes_and_digest}],sorted_expired_cohort_imports[{cohort_window_ref:StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortWindow>,prebootstrap_time_validation_evidence_artifact_identity_and_digest,prebootstrap_portable_expiry_attestation_ref:StrongRef<PreBootstrapPortableTimeExpiryAttestation>,historical_time_profile_and_verifier_evidence_commitment}],sorted_revoked_cohort_imports[{cohort_window_ref:StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortWindow>,issuer_fence_row_key,decision_record_digest,revocation_receipt_ref:StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortRevocationReceipt>,portable_terminal_evidence_ref:StrongRef<PortableExternalActionTerminalEvidence<PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortRevoke>>,prebootstrap_terminal_import_artifact_identity_bytes_and_digest}],sealed_prebootstrap_journal_lineage_commitment,complete_recipe_window_decision_issuer_cohort_disposition_action_and_artifact_bijection_commitment,complete_transcript_match_digest,body_digest}`. It deliberately contains no current RootSlot/manifest publication commitment, ordinary `ContinuityAuthorityObservationImport`, `TimeAuthorityObservationImport`, or canonical `TimeValidationEvidence`; those would create a pre-first-root cycle. Each issuer row has exactly one typed fence artifact import, each Expired cohort has exactly one prebootstrap validation/portable attestation import, and each Revoked cohort has exactly one action-typed receipt/evidence/artifact import.

After the bridge RootSlot is durable, the recovery-only ordered `PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierCanonicalValidateSpec<Role>` consumes that bootstrap import plus the exact current role root/configuration/writer-fence publication, a current `ContinuityAuthorityObservationImport<Role>` whose head equals the ancestry proof's allowed current descendant, and retained historical time-profile/verifier/registry-ancestry evidence for every Expired cohort. It does **not** require a fresh challenge to a retired old time epoch: expiry is monotone once a preserved signed attestation proves `observation_interval.earliest >= expires_at`, while fresh current continuity ancestry still proves no later prior-incarnation issuance path reopened. It creates `PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierCanonicalValidationRecord<Role> {authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,bootstrap_import_ref:StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierBootstrapImport<Role>>,current_configuration_writer_fence_and_publication_commitment,continuity_observation_import_ref:StrongRef<ContinuityAuthorityObservationImport<Role>>,sorted_expired_cohort_validations[{cohort_window_ref,prebootstrap_portable_expiry_attestation_ref:StrongRef<PreBootstrapPortableTimeExpiryAttestation>,historical_time_profile_ref,historical_verifier_key_and_retirement_floor_ref,historical_registry_ancestry_proof_ref,attestation_signature_window_and_subject_validation_digest}],exact_current_head_ancestry_recipe_window_decision_and_all_evidence_match_digest,assigned_role_maintenance_identity,body_digest}`. Restore reconciliation retains the bootstrap import until this record and its audit visibility are durable; readiness, Shard bootstrap projection, promotion, and ordinary service require the canonical validation record. Thus initial creation is acyclic, old valid backups do not depend on a long-retired clock service, and post-root operation still proves current continuity authority.

`ShardPriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierProjection` is the certified Meta projection `{source_meta_prefix,source_meta_configuration_identity,restore_id,prior_and_target_incarnations,barrier_identity_and_digest,meta_canonical_validation_record_identity_and_digest,complete_issuer_cohort_bijection_commitment,typed_projection_payload_identity_and_digest,projection_certificate_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<MetaControlProjectionCertificate>,retention_grant_and_payload_availability_evidence,body_digest}` using the exact `TypedCertifiedMetaProjectionPayload::PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrier` arm after `PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierCanonicalValidationRecord<Meta>` is durable and audit-visible. A Shard never imports raw continuity authority, reservation heads, fence receipts, or local time evidence. Omitted/duplicate issuer or cohort, a scalar expiry, unsigned range, future RestoreReserved reference, portable local reference, pre-validation projection, or ordinary-Protocol dispatch for these prebootstrap actions is invalid.

The three allocation-style reservations share one nonreuse protocol but have distinct bodies. `NewDatabaseIdentityTargetCreationCommitment` is the closed union `DirectoryBoundLocal{filesystem_domain_id,target_directory_claim,filesystem_profile_id,target_manifest_staging_recipe_digest,expected_mount_device_class,zero_existing_root_slot_proof_recipe_digest,fixed_local_continuity_recipe_digest}|ExternalCas{continuity_authority_domain,expected_absent_target_identity_basis,continuity_reservation_recipe_digest,target_posture:Local|Sharded}`. DirectoryBound is inhabitable only for a Local target; Meta/W12 and every Sharded target require ExternalCas. `NewDatabaseIdentityReservation` is `{reservation_id,restore_id,mode:CloneNewIdentity,new_database_id,new_database_security_namespace_id,target_creation_commitment:NewDatabaseIdentityTargetCreationCommitment,expected_target_incarnation,precommitted_claimant_ceiling_and_intended_use_template_digest,authority_epoch,time_authority_profile_oid,not_before,expires_at,issuance_nonce,signature}`. It never binds the prebootstrap journal inode, and an ExternalCas/Sharded reservation never pretends that one local target inode covers multiple groups.

`ServiceVisibilityEpochReservation` is `{reservation_id,database_id,database_security_namespace_id,cluster_incarnation,migration_nonce,source_posture:Local,target_posture:Sharded,source_service_visibility_epoch,target_service_visibility_epoch,external_service_epoch_floor,complete_target_group_topology_and_endpoint_commitment,expected_continuity_digest_and_cas_version,expected_catalog_version,authority_epoch,time_authority_profile_oid,not_before,expires_at,issuance_nonce,signature}`, with target strictly greater than both source and external floor. `AllocationEpochReservation` is `{reservation_id,restore_id,mode:RecoverSameIdentity|CloneNewIdentity,target_database_id,target_database_security_namespace_id,target_incarnation,source_manifest_digest,sorted_allocator_families[{allocator_kind,source_max_epoch,external_retired_floor,target_epoch,possibly_issued_source_ranges_digest,burn_through_range,successor_start}],complete_source_allocator_root_and_range_coverage_digest,external_allocator_floor_digest,precommitted_claimant_ceiling_and_intended_use_template_digest,authority_epoch,time_authority_profile_oid,not_before,expires_at,issuance_nonce,signature}`; every target epoch/range begins strictly beyond all source, external, restored, and possibly issued values with checked arithmetic. Under `AllocationContinuityProfile::DirectoryBound` — where mode is `CloneNewIdentity` only, since same-identity restore is forbidden in that posture — `external_retired_floor` and `external_allocator_floor_digest` are not fetched from any external authority: they are the registered floor digests of the source's fenced local allocation-continuity journal, authenticated from the source manifest closure, and the same strictly-beyond checked arithmetic applies against them; under `ExternalCas` they remain the external authority's floors exactly as stated.

Throughout restore, `journal_staging_inode_identity` means only the relocatable prebootstrap dispatch-cache inode, while `target_manifest_staging_inode_identity` means the eventual database `manifest.root` creation inode. They have distinct wire fields, proof types, fences, and negative substitution tests; no prose or encoder may abbreviate either as unqualified `staging_inode_identity`.

`ReservationBodyRef` is the closed noninterchangeable canonical union `NewDatabaseIdentity{body_ref:StrongRef<NewDatabaseIdentityReservation>}|ServiceVisibilityEpoch{body_ref:StrongRef<ServiceVisibilityEpochReservation>}|AllocationEpoch{body_ref:StrongRef<AllocationEpochReservation>}` and may appear only after target `K_oid` exists in Local/Meta authority-owning state. `PreBootstrapReservationBodyRef` is the separate closed union `NewDatabaseIdentity{artifact_ref:PreBootstrapArtifactRef<NewDatabaseIdentityReservation>}|AllocationEpoch{artifact_ref:PreBootstrapArtifactRef<AllocationEpochReservation>}`; ServiceVisibilityEpoch is never a restore-prebootstrap reservation. The first bridge copies exact bytes into target-keyed canonical reservation objects and proves a total artifact/body/head equality relation. Shards consume certified Meta reservation projections. Each selected arm's kind, reservation ID, authority epoch, profile/window, issuance nonce, and canonical body digest must byte-match the authority head; neither identity class accepts a raw body digest or an arm from the other class.

`ReservationAuthorityHead` is the external CAS-linear, reference-free `{authority_domain,reservation_kind,reservation_id,cas_version,predecessor_head_digest,monotonic_nonreuse_floor,issuance_body_digest,state:Reserved|ClaimedForUse{claim_id,intended_use_kind,intended_use_commitment,claimant_identity,claim_operation_id,claim_idempotency_key_digest,canonical_claim_request_digest,no_reassignment:true}|Consumed{claim_id,applied_use_identity,consume_operation_id,consume_idempotency_key_digest,canonical_consume_request_digest}|BurnedBeforeUse{claim_id?,stable_reason,no_matching_use_proof_digest,burn_operation_id,burn_idempotency_key_digest,canonical_burn_request_digest},authority_tick,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. A successor commits only pre-CAS request/operation facts and never its later receipt digest. Legal direct successors are exactly `Reserved -> ClaimedForUse -> Consumed`, `Reserved -> BurnedBeforeUse`, and `ClaimedForUse -> BurnedBeforeUse` with authority-verified no-use evidence. Expiry can authorize burn but never reuse; the nonreuse floor only advances. A claim has no timeout/reassignment path: exact retry joins it, a conflicting commitment fails, and recovery must consume or prove the fixed use absent before burn.

`PortableReservationAuthorityObservation` is the challenged/action-bound signed `{authority_domain,reservation_kind,reservation_id,current_head_bytes_and_digest,current_cas_version,current_state_projection,current_claim_and_intended_use_projection,monotonic_nonreuse_floor,intended_action:Claim|Consume|BurnBeforeUse|Status,canonical_action_body_digest,challenge_nonce,time_authority_observation_digest,time_authority_profile_oid,time_observation_interval:AuthorityInterval,authority_tick,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. `ReservationAuthorityObservationImport<Role:AuthorityOwningRole>` is the role-local `{role_and_group,current_configuration_writer_fence_and_publication_commitment,reservation_body_ref:ReservationBodyRef,current_head_ref:StrongRef<ReservationAuthorityHead>,portable_observation_ref:StrongRef<PortableReservationAuthorityObservation>,time_observation_import_ref:StrongRef<TimeAuthorityObservationImport>,time_validation_evidence_ref:StrongRef<TimeValidationEvidence>,exact_body_head_observation_time_and_action_match_digest,imported_at_maintenance_identity}`. Claim authorization requires a current Reserved observation and `TimeValidationEvidence::Usable`. Consume/burn authorization requires its exact current predecessor and the action-specific eligibility below; an observation never substitutes for dispatch publication.

Before target `K_oid`, `PreBootstrapReservationAuthorityObservationImport` is the distinct artifact schema `{reservation_body_ref:PreBootstrapReservationBodyRef,current_head_artifact_ref:PreBootstrapArtifactRef<ReservationAuthorityHead>,portable_observation_artifact_ref:PreBootstrapArtifactRef<PortableReservationAuthorityObservation>,prebootstrap_time_observation_import_artifact_ref:PreBootstrapArtifactRef<PreBootstrapTimeAuthorityObservationImport>,exact_body_head_observation_time_plan_and_action_match_digest,dispatch_root_generation}`. `PreBootstrapReservationBurnSource` is `Reserved{body_ref:PreBootstrapReservationBodyRef,current_head_and_observation_import_artifacts}|ClaimedUnused{body_ref,claimed_head_claim_receipt_terminal_evidence_and_import_artifacts,complete_no_use_proof}`. `PreBootstrapReservationBurnEligibility` is `ExpiredUnused{prebootstrap_expiry_observation_and_evidence_artifacts,portable_expiry_attestation_artifact_ref}|ExplicitAbandonment{sealed_zero_canonical_publication_proof,resource_disposition_authority}`. These are the only prebootstrap claim/burn inputs; ordinary role-local imports and Semantic visibility certificates are uninhabited before the first root.

The three typed portable terminal receipts all begin with the exact full request binding. `ReservationClaimReceipt` is `{external_request_binding:ExternalActionRequestBinding{action_kind=ReservationClaim},authority_domain,reservation_kind,reservation_id,reserved_head_digest_and_cas_version,claimed_head_bytes_and_digest_and_cas_version,claim_id,intended_use_kind,intended_use_commitment,claimant_identity,monotonic_nonreuse_floor,authority_tick,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. `ReservationConsumptionReceipt` is `{external_request_binding:ExternalActionRequestBinding{action_kind=ReservationConsume},authority_domain,reservation_kind,reservation_id,claim_id,intended_use_kind,intended_use_commitment,claimed_head_digest_and_cas_version,consumed_head_bytes_and_digest_and_cas_version,applied_use_identity,monotonic_nonreuse_floor,authority_tick,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. `ReservationBurnReceipt` is `{external_request_binding:ExternalActionRequestBinding{action_kind=ReservationBurnBeforeUse},authority_domain,reservation_kind,reservation_id,claim_id?,prior_head_digest_and_cas_version,burned_head_bytes_and_digest_and_cas_version,stable_reason,no_matching_use_proof_digest,monotonic_nonreuse_floor,authority_tick,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. From the durable hidden Meta recovery root, Meta issues `RestoreShardBootstrapProjection {restore_id,restore_epoch,shard_id,target_topology_and_configuration,service_visibility_epoch,continuity_recovery_only_projection_payload,allocation_epoch_shard_slice_payload:RestoreAllocationEpochShardSlicePayload,prior_lease_barrier_projection_payload,source_lease_projection_payload:ShardRestoreSourceLeaseProjectionPayload,archive_inventory_and_key_recipient_subset,shard_transform_recipe_commitment,expected_initial_semantic_protocol_prepared_consensus_bootstrap_slot_recipes,source_meta_prefix_and_configuration,retention_grant_and_payload_availability_evidence,projection_digest}` and `RestoreShardBootstrapProjectionCertificate {SameGroupCertificateHeader,projection_ref:StrongRef<RestoreShardBootstrapProjection>,projection_identity_and_digest,source_meta_hidden_root_and_slot_commitment,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}`. After verifying that CRSR and the slice, the Shard constructs consumer-local `ShardAllocationEpochAuthorityProjection {certified_bootstrap_projection_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<RestoreShardBootstrapProjectionCertificate>,slice_payload:RestoreAllocationEpochShardSlicePayload,source_meta_prefix_configuration_and_parent_allocation_commitment,local_allocator_registry_recipe_commitment,exact_certificate_slice_subset_partition_and_local_recipe_match_digest,body_digest}` and its `ShardRestoreSourceLeaseProjection`. Duplicate, overlapping, gapped, wrong-parent, wrong-prefix, wrong-topology, or wrong-configuration slices fail before bridge construction; no future-certificate cycle exists.

`ShardRecoveryPublicationGuard` is a nonserializable action-bound guard derived from the certified RecoveryOnly continuity payload plus a current member-bound lease, challenged continuity/time observation, local inode lease/fence, and current source Meta prefix/configuration. It is revalidated immediately before every immutable seal, plane-root, manifest, and RootSlot write and cannot authorize ordinary service. `PendingShardRestoreCreationGuard` is the separate linear `{certified_bootstrap_projection_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<RestoreShardBootstrapProjectionCertificate>,current_source_lease_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreSourceLeaseProjection>,shard_recovery_publication_guard:ShardRecoveryPublicationGuard,target_manifest_staging_inode_identity_and_filesystem_profile,local_whole_inode_lease,root_publication_sequencer,shard_projection_result_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationProjectionResult<Shard>>,initial_shard_protocol_prepared_consensus_recipes,complete_slot_bitmap,exact_allowed_shard_object_inventory,exact_shard_bridge_and_first_root_recipes,unconsumed}`. It contains no raw continuity record/lease, reservation body/head/observation, barrier import, Meta acquisition bundle, or canonical Meta source-lease record. A long build may accept only a certified same-restore/plan/shard lease-projection refresh for generation `g+1` with `LeaseWindowSuccessorProof`, unchanged authority/inventory/recipient subset, and current Meta prefix; old projections cease authorizing reads at expiry. Otherwise Meta must reissue the complete bootstrap projection.

Direct Local/Meta bridge ordering is canonical imports -> transform/projection -> initial objects -> bridge -> complete all-plane manifest/slot. Sharded ordering is Meta bridge/root -> certified shard bootstrap projections -> shard creation guards/bridges -> ready barriers. Each encoder permits only its role-valid acquisition/projection/current-authority/configuration/checkpoint/floor/initial-state/bridge closure and rejects Genesis, Operational, user work, ordinary receipts/Raft, service advertisement, or a second general command. It uses exclusive staging, full sync, no-replace rename, directory sync, inode revalidation, and exact publication permit/reread, then yields only `RecoveryWriterLeaseGuard`. Double-use, competing restore, lease expiry, missing opener, cross-role authority, omission, crash at every plane/root/external-finalize boundary, and checked-range exhaustion are permanent model/property/crash tests.

`RestoreReconciliationEvidenceRef<Role>` and `RestoreExplicitRetentionOwnerRef<Role>` are generated closed tagged unions over the role-valid `RegisteredStrongRef` targets for identity/allocation, privacy, audit, prepared/decision, cursor/delivery, resource, key, remote retention/trust, history, replay, backup, DP, derived state, and capability invalidation. `RestoreReconciliationRoot<Role>` has exactly one generated slot per activated class; each value is `Pending{reason_code}|Resolved{evidence:RestoreReconciliationEvidenceRef<Role>}|ExplicitlyRetained{owner:RestoreExplicitRetentionOwnerRef<Role>,floor,expiry_or_terminal_rule}|Disabled{exact_fail_closed_policy}`. `RestoreReconciliationCompletionProof<Role>` is `{restore_id,restore_epoch,role_and_group,reconciliation_root_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReconciliationRoot<Role>>,activated_slot_bitmap,resolved_slot_bitmap,explicitly_retained_slot_bitmap,disabled_slot_bitmap,zero_pending_proof,all_explicit_retention_rules_live_proof,complete_transform_projection_coverage_digest,checker_version}`. The four bitmaps are disjoint and exhaustive. `RestoreReconciliationStatus<Role>` is `Pending{unresolved_slot_bitmap}|Complete{proof_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReconciliationCompletionProof<Role>>}`; no nullable proof or inferred readiness exists.

`RestoreContinuityBasis<Role>` is the generated exact role family `Local{basis:DirectoryBound{creation_evidence_ref:StrongRef<DirectoryBoundCreationEvidence<Local>>,fixed_local_continuity_digest,target_manifest_inode_identity_and_fence_commitment}|ExternalCas{continuity_record_ref:StrongRef<ClusterIncarnationContinuityRecord>,head_digest_and_cas_version,recovery_lease_generation_and_lineage_commitment}}|Meta{continuity_record_ref:StrongRef<ClusterIncarnationContinuityRecord>,head_digest_and_cas_version,recovery_lease_generation_and_lineage_commitment}|Shard{continuity_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardContinuityAuthorityProjection>,source_meta_prefix_and_configuration,projected_head_digest_and_cas_version,recovery_only_member_lease_projection_commitment}`. Meta has no DirectoryBound arm; Shard has no raw continuity record/CAS authority. `RecoveryBridgeSourceLeaseBasis<Role>` is the generated exact `Local{lease_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRecord<Local>>,generation,portable_lease_state_digest}|Meta{lease_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRecord<Meta>>,generation,portable_lease_state_digest}|Shard{lease_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreSourceLeaseProjection>,generation,portable_lease_state_digest,certified_source_meta_prefix_and_configuration}`. Every field byte-matches `RecoveryBridgeAuthority<Role>`.

`RestoreStateCommon<Role>` is `{restore_id,restore_epoch,source_posture,source_manifest_identity,source_backup_incarnation,externally_retired_incarnation_floor,target_incarnation,service_visibility_epoch,target_role_and_group,continuity_basis:RestoreContinuityBasis<Role>,transform_plan_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationTransformPlan<Role>>,projection_result_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationProjectionResult<Role>>,source_lease_basis:RecoveryBridgeSourceLeaseBasis<Role>,target_configuration_and_topology_identity,reconciliation_root_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReconciliationRoot<Role>>,reconciliation_status:RestoreReconciliationStatus<Role>,service_gate:Hidden,state_generation}`.

`RestoreState` is the closed role union `Local{common:RestoreStateCommon<Local>,phase:Reconciling|VisibilityCommitted{activation_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}|ServicePreparedHidden{prepare_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}}|Meta{common:RestoreStateCommon<Meta>,phase:Reconciling|ActivationOrdered{activation_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}|VisibilityCommitted{visibility_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}|ServicePreparedHidden{prepare_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}}|Shard{common:RestoreStateCommon<Shard>,shard_id,phase:Reconciling|ActivationAppliedHidden{activation_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}|VisibilityApplied{visibility_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}|ServicePreparedHidden{prepare_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}}`. The generated role validator accepts only the matching Local, Meta, or Shard `AuthorityAppliedRef` arm. A ready certificate/barrier may be signed only over `Reconciling + Complete`; it is owned outside `RestoreState` by the certificate ledger after the source root exists. Each applied phase stores only its already identified input command plus assigned order—never the future command record, resulting root, post-apply certificate, or acknowledgement. `ServicePreparedHidden` additionally requires exact visibility evidence but does not clear the state or service gate. No ordinary work, session admission, endpoint advertisement, capability issuance, or result delivery is legal while `restore_state_ref` is present.

`RecoveryBridgeDependencyRef<Role>` is the generated closed union of role-valid recreated signing/wrap/verifier authority, identity/privacy/audit reconciliation-plan, and prepared/cursor/delivery/remote-obligation plan objects. `RecoveryBridgeAuthority<Role>` is the generated role family `Local{direct_creation_authority_ref:StrongRef<RestoreDirectCreationAuthorityRecord<Local>>,source_acquisition_bundle_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceAcquisitionBundle<Local>>,latest_source_lease_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRecord<Local>>}|Meta{direct_creation_authority_ref:StrongRef<RestoreDirectCreationAuthorityRecord<Meta>>,source_acquisition_bundle_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceAcquisitionBundle<Meta>>,latest_source_lease_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRecord<Meta>>}|Shard{certified_meta_bootstrap_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<RestoreShardBootstrapProjectionCertificate>,source_meta_prefix_configuration_and_trust_commitment,source_lease_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreSourceLeaseProjection>}`. Only the matching arm is inhabitable.

`InitialRestoreStateRef<Role>` is the generated tag-refined strong reference whose Local, Meta, and Shard concrete validators accept only the matching `RestoreState` role arm in `Reconciling` with `service_gate=Hidden`, complete role-valid common identity, and no future applied phase. `InitialRestoreRegistryRef<Role>` is the generated tag-refined strong reference whose Local/Meta validators accept only `Nonterminal{phase=ActiveHidden{restore_state_ref=the exact InitialRestoreStateRef<Role>},lease_state=Current{latest matching source lease record}}` and whose Shard validator accepts only `ActiveHidden` with the exact initial state, certified source-lease projection, transform/projection, Meta prefix/configuration, and no terminal/pin state. A generic `StrongRef<RestoreState|RestoreRegistry>` cannot inhabit a recovery bridge.

`RecoveryAllocationEpochAuthority<Role>` is the generated closed role family `Local{allocation_claim_import_ref:StrongRef<PreBootstrapReservationClaimCanonicalImportRecord<Local,AllocationEpoch>>,bootstrap_applied_use_identity:BootstrapReservationAppliedUseIdentity<Local,AllocationEpoch>,expected_initial_allocator_state_and_spent_range_recipe_commitment}|Meta{allocation_claim_import_ref:StrongRef<PreBootstrapReservationClaimCanonicalImportRecord<Meta,AllocationEpoch>>,bootstrap_applied_use_identity:BootstrapReservationAppliedUseIdentity<Meta,AllocationEpoch>,expected_initial_allocator_state_and_spent_range_recipe_commitment}|Shard{authority_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardAllocationEpochAuthorityProjection>,expected_initial_allocator_state_recipe_commitment}`. Local/Meta byte-match the exact claim import and the corresponding entry in the pending creation guard; Shard byte-matches only its certified consumer-local slice projection and never encodes a reservation head, receipt, or Local/Meta import.

`RecoveryBridgeSpec<Role>` is the exact role-specialized first-control body `{restore_id,restore_epoch,authority:RecoveryBridgeAuthority<Role>,source_manifest_identity_and_digest,transform_plan_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationTransformPlan<Role>>,projection_result_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationProjectionResult<Role>>,source_lease_basis:RecoveryBridgeSourceLeaseBasis<Role>,target_role_payload:RoleGeneratedRecoveryPayload<Role>,initial_restore_state_ref:InitialRestoreStateRef<Role>,initial_restore_registry_ref:InitialRestoreRegistryRef<Role>,initial_protocol_state_recipe_commitment,target_checkpoint_floor_and_prepared_consensus_body_recipe_commitments,allocation_epoch_authority:RecoveryAllocationEpochAuthority<Role>,dependency_refs[RecoveryBridgeDependencyRef<Role>],dependency_coverage_bitmap,complete_posture_field_slot_plane_and_object_coverage_digest,terminal_audit_gate:StructurallyInapplicable{RecoverySystemAuthority}}`. `RoleGeneratedRecoveryPayload<Local>` is `{target_configuration_ref,assigned_logical_command_origin}`; Meta adds topology and assigned global origin; Shard is `{shard_id,target_configuration_ref,target_topology_epoch,assigned_shard_raft_origin,certified_meta_bootstrap_identity}`. A Shard spec cannot encode Local/Meta external-authority refs.

The spec carries already-authenticated recipe commitments and earlier objects only, never future Protocol/Prepared/Consensus/manifest/slot identities. Its mode/role must match the guard, transform/projection, initial state/registry, and protocol recipe. Initial `RestoreState` and registry are built before the spec, hidden `Reconciling`/`ActiveHidden`, and name neither the spec nor future records. `RecoveryBridgeSpec<Local|Meta>` is consumed only by `PendingRestoreCreationGuard<Role>`; `RecoveryBridgeSpec<Shard>` only by `PendingShardRestoreCreationGuard` and outer `ShardControlAuthority::MetaAuthorized` naming the same certified bootstrap projection. Apply constructs the role payload and real role-valid command record, then the guard builds Protocol, Prepared, Consensus, manifest, and slot roots in universal order. Fresh Genesis alone has no head; restore never validates an old root as current and never creates a headless non-Genesis state.

No raw `[StrongRef]` bag is legal. For sharded restore, `RestoreShardReadyBarrier {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,restore_epoch,service_visibility_epoch,shard_id,target_domain,exact_global_barrier,target_topology_and_configuration,local_projection_result_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationProjectionResult<Shard>>,state_root_ref:StrongRef<ShardLogicalStateRoot>,ready_closure_inventory_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReadyClosureInventory<Shard>>,active_meta_projection_root_ref:StrongRef<ActiveMetaProjectionRoot>,reconciliation_completion_proof_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReconciliationCompletionProof<Shard>>,local_root_slot_durability_digest,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}` strongly owns the exact local closure. Its completion proof allows both Resolved and ExplicitlyRetained slots and rejects any Pending slot.

`GlobalRestoreActivationSpec` is `{restore_id,expected_meta_state:WeakStateIdentity,exact_global_barrier,expected_topology_and_meta_configuration,meta_reconciliation_proof_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReconciliationCompletionProof<Meta>>,meta_ready_closure_inventory_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReadyClosureInventory<Meta>>,exact_sorted_ready_barrier_refs[CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<RestoreShardReadyBarrier>],complete_group_partition_and_authority_commitment,continuity_reservation_digest,recovery_lease_generation,service_visibility_epoch,terminal_audit_gate}`. After apply and the exact audit visibility advance, Meta creates `GlobalRestoreActivationCertificate {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,activation_record_ref:StrongRef<GlobalControlRecord>,exact_global_barrier,topology_and_meta_configuration_identity,sorted_ready_barrier_identities,complete_group_partition_and_authority_commitment,post_apply_global_state_root_ref:StrongRef<GlobalStateRoot>,service_visibility_epoch,visibility_certificate_ref:StrongRef<PortableSemanticVisibilityCertificate<Meta>>,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}`. `ShardRestoreActivationApplySpec` is `{activation_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<GlobalRestoreActivationCertificate>,own_ready_barrier_ref:StrongRef<RestoreShardReadyBarrier>,expected_local_restore_state:WeakStateIdentity,expected_topology_configuration_and_remote_trust_selector,exact_typed_restore_projection_payload}` and leaves the shard hidden. Each shard orders `ShardRestoreServicePrepareSpec {prepare_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<GlobalRestoreServicePrepareCertificate>,own_visibility_ack_ref:StrongRef<RestoreShardVisibilityAck>,expected_local_restore_state:WeakStateIdentity,expected_topology_configuration_and_remote_trust_selector,service_visibility_epoch}` under the outer exact `MetaAuthorized` row, remains hidden, and emits `RestoreShardServiceReadyAck {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,prepare_identity,own_visibility_ack_identity,post_prepare_state_root_ref:StrongRef<ShardLogicalStateRoot>,applied_shard_raft_index,service_visibility_epoch,service_gate:Hidden,root_slot_durability_digest,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}`.

## Ownership, verification, and diagnostics
For every schema, field, tag, state, transition, reference, digest transcript, construction-order rule, and role restriction in this slice, generate a durable_fields.toml row with stable IDs; canonical encoding/version policy; concrete generic/role expansion; producer, owner bead/crate, and consumers; reference strength/target set; authority and redaction class; invariant/evidence/cost bindings; test/scenario/event IDs; and consuming gate. Cross-slice targets use stable catalog IDs and must resolve in the Appendix A epic closure. Downstream owners may add implementation detail but cannot abbreviate, alias, weaken, or contradict these bytes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The embedded line range is byte-complete, checksum-pinned, continuous with adjacent slices, and contains no truncation marker.
- Every exact named construct in the slice has one stable row and exactly one granular implementation owner; all references and consumers resolve.
- Unit tests cover canonical encode/decode, stable field/tag IDs, role/generic expansion, digest construction, state preconditions, and owner uniqueness.
- Property/mutation/fuzz tests remove, duplicate, reorder, retag, corrupt, weaken, or cross-role substitute every field/arm/reference class and prove rejection.
- Simulation tests exercise applicable crash, cancellation, retry, sent-unknown, receipt-first, recovery, authority/configuration rotation, compaction, and expiry boundaries.
- E2E scripts traverse each applicable public embedded/server/FGP/CLI path through durable publication, restart/replay, backup/restore, and terminal cleanup using isolated synthetic fixtures.
- Detailed versioned JSONL diagnostics carry schema_id, field_or_arm_id, role/group, object or public commitment, transition_id, state_before/state_after, checker, verdict, artifact refs, and replay command; secret/noninterference tests reject protected data or observable hidden state.
- Cross-version golden vectors and unknown-required-field fixtures enforce additive-minor/breaking-major policy; no gate passes with an uncovered row.

## Risks & rejected alternatives
Rejected: family-level prose summaries, wildcard references, inferred fields, unregistered aliases, or treating the catalog slice as the implementation. Exactness is intentional; execution remains decomposed across the linked workstream beads.

## THE RED

  FAILED — 129 passed, 1 failed, exit 101.
  left: "fnv1a64:008870269f402db8"  (panic at tests/identity.rs:9859)

Two .git-free quiet roots built with `git archive <sha> | tar -x`, then the rustc recipe, then

early-return a false green (that early return is why a missing corpus reads as `ok. 1 passed`):

    19ea99b  (the a20 landing)             ->  FAILED.         exit 101

[fgdb-a20-restore-promotion-ivsp]". The only other commits in the window touched
.beads/issues.jsonl alone, which the witness transcript does not read.

FORWARD pin (tools/registry-check/src/identity.rs, FIELDS
"fnv1a64:a337b796abfbdfcc" -> "fnv1a64:8a2eff046882cedd"). That part is right and should stay.

What is missing is the HISTORICAL side. `idr_assignment_history_and_epoch_are_frozen`
reconstructs the PRE-erratum namespace, so a post-erratum row must be FILTERED OUT of the
reconstruction — never compensated for by re-pinning. The two new rows are unfiltered, so their
lines move the historical hash. The witness transcript is not only fields: assignment_pins
folds in reference unions, ordinary unions, and every ARM of both, which is why this moves even
though only field rows were added.

DO NOT re-pin A10_COMMAND_REF_ERRATUM_PREVIOUS_FIELDS_PIN. The test's own panic message records
that it "was re-pinned to conceal a mismatch once at 8a704c2 and is why this failure recurred",

WHICH ROWS THE FILTER NOW ADMITS, AND WHY EACH BELONGS TO THE POST-ERRATUM COHORT
New sibling closure post_erratum_a20_field, kept separate from
post_erratum_a20_promotion_field_tranche rather than folded into it, so each landing's admissions
